title: Day 11: The Contest Entry Runs From Scratch. Two Computers Still Wait
summary: The contest entry installs and passes its tests from a fresh copy, and the headless root kept checking all day. Current usage readings are fresh again, but the missing hours and the amount of useful work are still unknown.
